items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And then I had my brother-in-law playing guitar with me. Eddie Palu, that's the same name.

ctx.x: Yeah. You was a leader and he was a manager or what? I didn't work. I was a leader, manager, and everything.

Yeah. At that time. You had your own bass. Yeah. And then I had my brother-in-law playing guitar with me. Eddie Palu, that's the same name. Eddie Thomas playing drums. That's my old drummer where I first started. And Harold. Harold. That was my main man, yeah. And you lived over here? No. I used to stay on vacation time and on weekends, you know. Then I wouldn't come over here on weekends when they'd send for me. I'd send for him. I'd send for him. And that guy, I mean, associate used to send for Clayton a lot of…
Well, how did you work that then? You mostly had jobs on the weekend when you lived here.
